text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О often makes a dramatic
entrance,
even if its just to a training
session.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm awaiting her lively arrival,
wondering
whether she'll be dancing or
singing, when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Good day, Trainer! And what a fine day
it is!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
She's decided to wear her signature
racewear.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ensnared by my charm, are you? I
certainly can't
blame you for that.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Not after I spent the past two hours
admiring my
regal self in the mirror.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list:
Huh... So why'd you choose your racewear to
train in?

text_block_list.text:
For the sake of all involved in the race,
of course!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I am far too dangerous when racing in
these
clothes, for those who gaze upon
me become lost
in a labyrinth of allure.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Like moths to the flame, my sweet fans
are
inevitably drawn to tragedy—only
once I have
crossed the finish line do
they awaken.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: As such, what is there to be done? The answer is simple!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Before the race takes place, I shall allow
them the
chance to grow accustomed to
this visage!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Oh, I assure you, it can be done. After all, I am the culmination of all forms of beauty the world over!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
This doesn't precisely explain why she's
wearing
her racewear today, but I put
that aside for the
moment.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: You sure like your signature racewear.

text_block_list.text:
But of course! This ensemble befits my
splendor!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: I'll show you... This way, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О suddenly sprints away,
and I follow
after her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Behold! These golden accessories—do
they not
glisten in the sunlight?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Heh! My royal mantle, boldly fluttering
in the
wind!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Wait for it!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I am eternal beauty, the light of the
world, the
majesty of outer space...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I am the enrapturer of all—the Centurial

Overlord!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Has more perfect attire ever existed? Nay, this is a revolution! I have become a living piece of design history!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: And though this racewear's form is exquisite, one mustn't forget what lies at its source—a fabulous concept, that I created!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list: You always know what you want.

text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes... It is a well-known fact that I
make
every style look great.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
This one was designed to be most
suitable for me.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Do you know why that is?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list: It carries the air of the Overlord.
It depicts the strength to meet expectations.

text_block_list.text:
Exactly! The same holds true of my
noble mantle
and adornments! They
comprise my throne when I
race!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Those who behold me striding down the
turf do
not gaze in fear of my power. No!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: They gaze with envy and admiration!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
They may close their eyes, but I will still
be
there—my burning figure afire in their
hearts.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
However! Even if it brings them to their
knees, I
only wish for my brilliance to
leave them
reassured.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I will extend a hand of invitation to
them—to walk
together toward a stage
worthy of the Centurial
Overlord!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes, Trainer! You are but one of
many with
great expectations of me.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Nay, to say "many" is an understatement.
Is it not
obvious the entire world
anticipates my coming
excellence?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Thus, I hereby declare, that I shall never
betray
their expectations!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
This attire comprises my throne when I
race! The
masses shall come to seek my
beauty.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I say to them, come to the G1 caroling
my name!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Come, and I shall greet you with more
radiance
yet!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
For that is my duty—as the one who
walks the
Overlord's path!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Her enthusiasm is palpable. As her
trainer, I'll do
everything I can to help
make that dream come
true.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I've got it! I shall gift you an outfit as
well, so you
might stand beside me!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Neither the sun nor moon can rise
without the sky.
Thus, that is what you
shall become! First, your
full body
should have a base of sky blue...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I get the sense we're walking into
dangerous
territory. I'd better stop her
while we're ahead!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With how particular she is in her design,
it's
obvious how strongly Opera O feels
about her
racewear.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
